subtitle: The driver whose personnel file the game writes: hours, kilometres, punctuality, tickets.
loadFailed: Could not read the personnel file
noDriverHint: Create a driver to start a personnel file. Every drive adds to it.
noFile: No personnel file yet. The game writes it after your first run.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.hint: How the passengers and the depot see your driving, over all your runs.
ratings.drivingHint: Speeding, harsh braking and crashes lower it.
ratings.comfortHint: The share of passengers who got on and had nothing to complain about.
ratings.ticketsHint: Right ticket, right change, without keeping anyone waiting.

runs.title: Recent drives
runs.noneHint: Drive a duty and it shows up here.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.hint: Every driver keeps a personnel file of their own. The game writes the runs to the chosen one.
drivers.confirmText: The personnel file with level, kilometres and ratings is deleted for good. Runs already recorded stay in the history.

create.title: New driver
create.hint: A fresh personnel file, starting at level 1. You switch to the new driver straight away.
create.name: Name
create.taken: There already is a driver called {name}.
